name: greenfield
requirement: Build a URL shortener service. Users submit a long URL and receive a short link; visiting the short link redirects to the original URL. Link owners can see how many times a link was clicked, broken down per day. The service will be exposed on the public internet, so it must not become a tool for abuse.
constraints:
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5.x, Gradle Kotlin DSL using the Gradle wrapper already in the repository.
Single-module project at the repository root (settings.gradle.kts, build.gradle.kts, src/).
Base package io.github.hemanthvk980.shortener. PostgreSQL + Flyway in production; H2 (PostgreSQL mode) for local runs and tests.
Errors as RFC 7807 problem details. No secrets in code or config: use environment variables.
Tests: JUnit 5, Spring Boot test + MockMvc.

design: APPROVED: API contract and task plan look right; 302 (not 301) agreed so expiry and analytics keep working
implementation: APPROVED: build file uses Boot-managed versions only; V1 migration reviewed
release-readiness: APPROVED: checklist green, risks acknowledged; ship to staging
